name: CodeGenie AI
description: AI-powered coding assistant that helps you write, review, and refactor code. Supports multiple languages and frameworks including Python, JavaScript, Rust, Go, and TypeScript. Features include real-time suggestions, code explanation, test generation, and documentation writing.
description_markdown:
## Features

- **Smart Autocomplete** — Context-aware code suggestions as you type
- **Code Review** — Automated review with security and best practice checks
- **Refactoring** — One-click refactoring suggestions
- **Multi-language** — Supports 20+ programming languages
- **Privacy-first** — All processing happens locally

## Getting Started

```bash
ato run aigit-lab/ai-code-assistant
```

## Configuration

Set your preferred model and temperature in the settings panel.
